d: Divali ka mausam hai, aap sabko raushni ka tyauhar mubarak ho. aapke jivan men khushhali, aur sanpannata ka ujala phaile. lage hath thora sa khyal aap nyuzlondri aur aazad patrakarita ki bhi rakhie. ek sau ekh rupae ke shubh shagun ke sath is divali aap nyuzlondri ko sabsakraib kijie. jo kabhi kahte phirte the ki ham phakir hain, jhola lekar chal denge. vo jab jane ka mausam aaya to kah rahe ki modi kahin kahin nahin jaega. ji han. modiji aur unke shagird bakayda dhol harmuniya lekar ootaru ho gae hain ki ham kursi nahin chhorenge.
